```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

```{r meta-block, echo=FALSE, results="asis"}
if (!is.null(params$meta)) {
  m <- params$meta
  fmt_ha <- function(x) format(round(x), big.mark = ".", decimal.mark = ",",
                                scientific = FALSE)
  parts <- character(0)
  if (!is.null(m$year))    parts <- c(parts, paste0("\\textbf{Inventurjahr:} ",      as.integer(m$year)))
  if (!is.null(m$area_ha)) parts <- c(parts, paste0("\\textbf{Gesamtfl\\\"ache:} ", fmt_ha(m$area_ha), " ha"))
  if (!is.null(m$n_plots)) parts <- c(parts, paste0("\\textbf{Inventurpunkte:} ",   as.integer(m$n_plots)))
  if (length(parts) > 0)
    cat("\\begin{center}\\small ", paste(parts, collapse = "\\qquad "), "\\end{center}\\vspace{-0.5em}\n", sep = "")
}
```

```{r, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE}

oo <- options(knitr.kable.NA = "", fe_spec_lang = "ger")

x <- params$x

# ------------ Recode Zustand and species groups -------------------

x <- x |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    zustand = dplyr::case_when(
      dw_state == 92 ~ "Liegendes Totholz",
      dw_state %in% c(90, 91) ~ "Stehendes Totholz",
      dw_state == 100 ~ "Gesamt",
      TRUE ~ as.character(dw_state)
    ),
    species_group = dplyr::case_when(
      species_group == 0   ~ "nz",
      species_group == 1   ~ "NdH",
      species_group == 2   ~ "Ei",
      species_group == 3   ~ "üLbH",
      species_group == 999 ~ "Summe",
      TRUE ~ as.character(species_group)
    )
  )

# --- enforce Zustand order ---
zustand_order <- c("Liegendes Totholz", "Stehendes Totholz", "Gesamt")
x$zustand <- factor(x$zustand, levels = zustand_order)

# --- enforce species group order ---
species_order <- c("nz", "NdH", "Ei", "üLbH", "Summe")
x$species_group <- factor(x$species_group, levels = species_order)

# --- sort table ---
x <- x |>
  dplyr::arrange(zustand, species_group)

# vertical grouping index (Zustand bands)
vertical_index_dat <- x |>
  dplyr::group_by(zustand) |>
  dplyr::summarise(n = dplyr::n(), .groups = "drop")

vertical_index <- vertical_index_dat$n
names(vertical_index) <- vertical_index_dat$zustand

# extract global totals for subtitle (they should be constant)
total_n_points <- unique(x$n_points_tot)
total_area_ha  <- unique(x$area_ha_tot)

if (length(total_n_points) > 1 || length(total_area_ha) > 1) {
  warning("n_points_tot or area_ha_tot vary by row; using first value for header subtitle.")
}
total_n_points <- total_n_points[1]
total_area_ha  <- total_area_ha[1]

# remove state & global total columns from table body
x <- x |>
  dplyr::ungroup() |>
  dplyr::select(-dw_state, -zustand, -n_points_tot, -area_ha_tot)

# ------------ Identify diameter class columns -----------------------

all_names <- names(x)

# diameter-class columns end with "(a,b]"
is_diam_col <- grepl("_\\([^]]+\\]$", all_names)
diam_names  <- all_names[is_diam_col]

# extract distinct intervals (e.g. "20,35", "35,46", "46,999")
get_interval <- function(nm) sub(".*_\\(([^]]+)\\]$", "\\1", nm)
intervals <- unique(vapply(diam_names, get_interval, FUN.VALUE = character(1)))

# order by lower bound
lower <- as.numeric(sub(",.*", "", intervals))
intervals_ord <- intervals[order(lower)]

# columns per interval
class_cols <- lapply(intervals_ord, function(iv) {
  grep(paste0("_\\(", iv, "\\]$"), all_names, value = TRUE)
})
names(class_cols) <- intervals_ord

# ------------ Reorder columns: BaGr, diam blocks, trailing ----------

id_cols    <- c("species_group")
other_cols <- setdiff(all_names, c(id_cols, diam_names))

ordered_cols <- c(
  id_cols,
  unlist(class_cols, use.names = FALSE),
  other_cols
)

x <- x[, ordered_cols, drop = FALSE]

# ------------ Shorten metric names (keep interval in header band) ----

short_metric_name <- function(nm) {
  m <- regexec("^(v_m3|v_m3_pct_state|v_m3_pct_species|n_stems|n_pct_state|n_pct_species)_\\([^]]+\\]$", nm)
  parts <- regmatches(nm, m)[[1]]
  if (length(parts) == 0) return(nm)

  metric <- parts[2]

  metric_short <- switch(metric,
    "v_m3"             = "fm",
    "v_m3_pct_state"   = "fm-%Ges",
    "v_m3_pct_species" = "fm-%Ba",
    "n_stems"          = "N",
    "n_pct_state"      = "N-%Ges",
    "n_pct_species"    = "N-%Ba",
    metric
  )

  metric_short
}

new_names <- vapply(names(x), short_metric_name, FUN.VALUE = character(1))

# nice label for BaGr column
new_names[new_names == "species_group"] <- "BaGr"

# totals in Summe block
new_names[new_names == "total_v_m3"]    <- "fm"
new_names[new_names == "total_n_stems"] <- "N"
new_names[new_names == "n_points"]      <- "Anz.Pkt"
new_names[new_names == "area_ha"]      <- "Fläche(ha)"

names(x) <- new_names

# ------------ Header bands ------------------------------------------

# counts per interval (use class_cols lengths)
len_per_interval <- vapply(class_cols, length, integer(1))

# BaGr is the only ID column now
n_id    <- 1
n_diam  <- length(diam_names)
n_other <- length(other_cols)

# outer band: BaGr | all diam cols | trailing
header_outer <- c(
  n_id,
  n_diam,
  n_other
)
names(header_outer) <- c(
  " ",
  "Durchmesserklassen",
  " "
)

# inner band: BaGr | per interval | trailing (Summe with subtitle)
interval_labels <- vapply(intervals_ord, function(iv) {
  lo <- sub(",.*", "", iv)
  hi <- sub(".*,", "", iv)
  if (hi == "999") {
    paste0(">= ", lo, " cm")
  } else {
    paste0(lo, "-", hi, " cm")
  }
}, FUN.VALUE = character(1))



header_inner <- c(
  n_id,
  len_per_interval,
  n_other
)

summe_label = "Summe"


names(header_inner) <- c(
  " ",
  interval_labels,
  summe_label
)
# total number of columns in the table body

header_top <- ncol(x)


top_label <- sprintf(
  "Punkte mit Totholz = %s, Rep. Fläche mit Totholz = %s ha",
  format(total_n_points, big.mark = ".", decimal.mark = ","),
  format(total_area_ha, big.mark = ".", decimal.mark = ",")
)

names(header_top) <-  c(
  top_label
)
# ------------ Render table --------------------------------------

knitr::kable(
  x,
  booktabs    = TRUE,
  longtable   = TRUE,
  digits      = 1,
  format.args = list(scientific = FALSE),
  align       = "r"
) |>
  kableExtra::add_header_above(header_inner) |>
  kableExtra::add_header_above(header_outer) |>
  kableExtra::add_header_above(header_top) |>
  kableExtra::pack_rows(
    index        = vertical_index,
    hline_before = TRUE,
    hline_after  = FALSE
  ) |>
  kableExtra::kable_styling(
    font_size    = 6,
    latex_options = "repeat_header"
  ) |> 
  kableExtra::column_spec(2:(1 + n_diam), width = "0.7cm")

options(oo)


```
